strategy: Prioritize stage unlocks, relics and coffins that open several follow-up trophies. Whenever possible, stack multiple objectives from the same stage into a single run.

sources.label: TrueAchievements — Yellow Sign / late-game progression notes

roadmap.name: Coffin: Inlaid Library
roadmap.reason: A quick cleanup objective on an early stage, and it unlocks Giovanna for later character-specific trophies.

roadmap.name: Hyper Gallo Tower
roadmap.reason: The required boss spawns at the 25-minute mark, so this is easy to combine with other Gallo Tower objectives.

roadmap.name: Coffin: Gallo Tower
roadmap.reason: Unlocks Concetta, which opens additional character and weapon-related trophies.

roadmap.name: Cappella Magna
roadmap.reason: A major progression milestone that advances the base-game stage chain and unlocks several late-game objectives.

roadmap.name: Magic Banger
roadmap.reason: A fast relic pickup that also counts toward the standard-relic chain required for Eudaimonia.

roadmap.name: Glass Vizard
roadmap.reason: Unlocks the merchant on other stages and is a simple purchase once Moongolow is available.

roadmap.name: Yellow Sign
roadmap.reason: A key progression unlock: it reveals the Rings and Metaglio items needed for Infinite Corridor and Crimson Shroud.

roadmap.name: Seeker of the Infinite Corridor
roadmap.reason: Very useful for long survival runs and 31-minute objectives.

roadmap.name: Seeker of the Crimson Shroud
roadmap.reason: A major survivability tool, especially useful for 31-minute runs and Reaper-related goals.

roadmap.name: Great Gospel
roadmap.reason: A major Cappella Magna relic that unlocks Limit Break.

roadmap.name: Forbidden Scrolls
roadmap.reason: Unlocks the Secrets menu and is one of the standard relics required to reach Eudaimonia.

roadmap.name: The Eudaimonia Machine
roadmap.reason: The main late-game progression hub, unlocked after collecting all standard relics.

roadmap.name: Seventh Trumpet
roadmap.reason: One half of the Eudaimonia progression sequence.

roadmap.name: Gracia's Mirror
roadmap.reason: The other half of the Eudaimonia progression sequence.

roadmap.name: Greatest Jubilee
roadmap.reason: The payoff at the end of the base-game progression chain.

Coffin: Inlaid Library.tip: In Inlaid Library, travel far to the right. With the Milky Way Map unlocked, follow the question-mark marker, defeat every guardian around the coffin, then step onto the coffin once it becomes accessible.

Hyper Gallo Tower.tip: Stay in Gallo Tower until 25:00. The Giant Enemy Crab spawns automatically at that point. Build for strong area damage and survivability before minute 25, then kill it to unlock Hyper mode.

Coffin: Gallo Tower.tip: Head north toward the coffin marker. The coffin is inside a secret room reached through a glowing mirror on the left side of the tower. Enter the mirror, kill the guardians, then open the coffin to unlock Concetta.

Cappella Magna.tip: Reach level 80 in Gallo Tower. Try to combine this with the 25-minute crab kill, the Gallo Tower coffin and any relic pickups so one long run clears several objectives at once.

O'Sole Meeo.tip: Dragon Shrimps appear in Gallo Tower, so let this kill counter progress naturally while you work on the stage's coffin, boss and level objectives instead of farming it in a separate run.

Magic Banger.tip: Pick up the Magic Banger relic in Green Acres. Once the stage is available, follow the relic marker and grab it during another unlock run rather than dedicating a full session to it.

Glass Vizard.tip: First unlock Moongolow by opening Hyper mode on four normal stages. In Moongolow, buy the Glass Vizard from the merchant near the starting area; keep at least 10,000 gold ready.

Yellow Sign.tip: Use a non-secret character in Moongolow and survive until the special end-of-stage sequence. You will be sent to Holy Forbidden with your build stripped away; run through the corridor and collect the Yellow Sign at the end.

Seeker of the Infinite Corridor.tip: After obtaining the Yellow Sign, collect Clock Lancet, Silver Ring and Gold Ring. Max all three, then open an eligible chest to evolve Clock Lancet into Infinite Corridor. Consider leveling Gold Ring late because it also strengthens enemies.

Seeker of the Crimson Shroud.tip: After obtaining the Yellow Sign, collect Laurel, Metaglio Left and Metaglio Right. Max all three, then open an eligible chest to evolve Laurel into Crimson Shroud. Level Metaglio Right late if the enemy-strength increase is making the run harder.

Forbidden Scrolls.tip: In The Bone Zone, hunt Sketamari at the moving question-mark marker. Level up away from it first, because it absorbs nearby enemies and becomes stronger over time; then burst it down and collect the relic it drops.

Great Gospel.tip: In Cappella Magna, complete the late-stage boss sequence and defeat the final enemy tied to the stage. Pick up the Great Gospel relic that appears afterward to unlock Limit Break.

The Eudaimonia Machine.tip: Check the relic icons on the stage-select screen and collect every standard relic you are still missing. Once all standard relics are obtained, Eudaimonia becomes available as the next progression step.

patternTips.tip: For a standard evolution, max the required weapon, own its matching passive item, then open an eligible chest. Whenever possible, pair the evolution with a character survival or stage objective in the same run.

For level-based goals, prioritize experience gain and pickup efficiency. Crown is helpful for faster XP and Attractorb reduces time wasted collecting gems. Stack the level target with a 15- or 30-minute character objective when possible.

Treat survival trophies as stackable objectives. Build for consistency, then use the same run to complete weapon evolutions, character unlocks or stage-specific tasks instead of running the clock alone.
The Milky Way Map makes coffin runs much easier: follow the question-mark marker, kill the special guardians surrounding the coffin, then step onto it once it becomes available.
Do not hard-farm this counter too early. First identify the stage where the enemy naturally appears, then let the counter build while completing other objectives on that stage.
